findings.current: The second son of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.

escalation.reason: The source identifies Lee Seogeun as the Sect Leader’s blood relative who inherited his martial arts, then calls him the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s second son; the son is the leader’s, not the organization’s.
